prompts.text: 回复以下评论：最近我过了40岁生日，预定了晚上7点在一家不错的餐厅吃饭。考虑到交通和接爸爸，我计划在6:30离开。结果我发现我丈夫（43岁男性）还在忙着修车，没有准备好。虽然我催促他赶紧，到了6:50，他还没准备好，我不想错过我们的预订，所以我带着孩子离开了。他经常迟到，但我不能容忍他在我特别的晚餐上迟到。尽管我们迟到了，但我们的预定还有效，但我丈夫没有加入我们，我们回来后感到很不高兴。我表达了我对他惯常迟到的沮丧。我爸爸支持我的决定，虽然孩子们很失望他错过了晚餐。
prompts.english_original: Write a reply message to the following comment: I turned 40 recently and had booked a 7pm dinner at a nice restaurant. Planning to leave at 6:30pm to account for traffic and picking up my dad, I found my husband (43 M) still working on his car, not ready to go. Despite urging him to hurry, by 6:50, he wasn't ready, so I left with the kids, not wanting to miss our reservation. He often runs late, but I couldn't tolerate it for my special dinner. We kept our table despite arriving late, but my husband didn't join us and was upset upon our return. I expressed my frustration with his habitual tardiness. My dad supported my decision, though the kids were disappointed he missed the dinner.

prompts.text: 回复以下评论：我[31岁男性]投资了一辆昂贵的公路自行车作为我的主要交通工具，但上周被我的表弟Brad[15岁男性]偷走，并被监控录像拍到。在我报案之前，他的父母与他对质，然后自己的自行车也被偷了。我要求Brad富有的父母赔偿，但得知由于我叔叔[50多岁男性]失业和上瘾问题，他们面临财务问题。尽管他们遭遇了困境，我并不同情他们，因为他们以前对我的家庭的很傲慢。我给了我叔叔最后通牒，要他在周日午夜之前支付自行车的钱，否则我将向警察报告偷窃，并提供所有证据。截止日期已经过去，他们没有支付，所以我计划明天报警举报Brad。
prompts.english_original: Write a reply message to the following comment: I [31M] invested in an expensive road bike as my main transport, but last week, it was stolen and captured on security footage by my cousin Brad [15M]. By the time I reported it and his parents confronted him, the bike was stolen from Brad too. I requested reimbursement from Brad's wealthy parents, but learned they're facing financial issues due to my uncle's [50s M] job loss and addictions. Despite their hardships, I feel no sympathy due to their past arrogance towards my family. I gave my uncle an ultimatum to pay for the bike by Sunday midnight or I'd report the theft to the police with all evidence. The deadline has passed without payment, so I plan to report Brad to the police tomorrow.
